heading: Automated footfall marketing
subhead: Turn the services and experiences you already offer into discoverable events that give customers a reason to visit — and return.

beats.title: Marketing up to 30 days out, not just today's discovery
beats.text: Trivia, live music, comedy, and every match on every screen — published up to a month ahead in the same Portal.

beats.title: The build-up and the analysis, not just the 90 minutes
beats.text:
Pre-game, game and post-game - Audeohost gives your guests the TV commentary on their phone.
If you switch to music at half-time, game watchers can stick with the half-time show and never miss a beat. Post game is the same, they still have the commentary so nothing's lost.

beats.title: Connect once, stay top of the list
beats.text: Guests who favourite your venue on Audeohost sees it promoted first the next time they're deciding where to go. Audeohost is the source for every event at that venue, from day one. You are still on the events list so your venue is key in the area.

beatStrip: Audeohost is your whole venue, a month out. Customers connect, find your events, your location, and know where to go in future.
